newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore sees CPI below 2.0 pct in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Singapore sees CPI below 2.0 pct in 1996.

text.p: Singapore said on Friday it expected its consumer price index (CPI) of inflation to be below 2.0 percent year-on-year for the whole of 1996.
Ministry of Trade and Industry officials told a briefing the trend would be the same in 1997.
They said inflation for the year would be low because the Singapore dollar would continue to be strong.
The economy was also open and competitive which would produce downward pressure on prices, they said.
